case_authoring_contract.player_facing_mystery_or_question: What was the Mouth built to do, why do its repeated marks read like ritual commands, and why do the surviving copies disagree?
case_authoring_contract.plausible_initial_belief_or_misread: The Mouth is the ceremonial entrance to an occult institution and its repeated marks are rites imposed from the beginning.
case_authoring_contract.human_stake_and_character_relationship: Families, children, clerks, repair workers, and neighbors survived together; the language that kept them alive was gradually used to record and punish compliance.
case_authoring_contract.exact_canon_belief_earned_at_the_fixed_r: C02 only: the Hold was a functioning rational refuge before ritual institution.
case_authoring_contract.evidence_roles_distributed_across_surfac: Minecraft supplies lived place, physical records, altered notices, ordinary wear, and the impossible register; Copperline supplies mkept's modern custody, version comparison, node-clock corroboration, unrelated community texture, and immutable archive context.
case_authoring_contract.what_players_must_infer_rather_than_retr: The marks began as practical shift and emergency instructions; ordinary households used the Hold; a later office copy converted contingent advice into enforceable duty; an exact duplicated entry predates its stated source without ordinary clock failure; together these establish refuge-before-rite and safety-becoming-obedience.
case_authoring_contract.meaningful_recontextualization_or_callba: mkept's mundane C01 backup warning—compare copies by cartridge sequence, not filename or modified time—becomes the provenance key for the Mouth copies. A repeated mark first read as rite becomes a child's work exercise, then an attendance rule.
case_authoring_contract.consequence_world_npc_or_media_response_: The controlled gate opens onto a quiet civic readback: household repairs and names remain visible while the later attendance stamp is left physically separate. Copperline's fixture exposes a read-only comparison receipt without rewriting its older pages.
case_authoring_contract.fair_alternate_and_catch_up_routes_witho: The exact conclusions accept remembered or shared wording with zero source observations. Each belief has a Minecraft-first route and a Copperline-first route; immutable readback and a director-approved H1-H3 matrix can restore context without adding evidence.
case_authoring_contract.accessibility_outage_replay_restart_and_: All visual records have text equivalents; color is never the only distinction; no sound/time/debug/voice gate exists; Copperline outage has an in-world archive-copy fallback; journal state is local-primary, idempotent, replayable, and independent of participant touch parity.
case_authoring_contract.novelty_comparison_against_adjacent_and_: Unlike C01 web address/provenance recovery and P5 civic ethnography, P4 uses a modern backup rule to compare ancient versions, sustains a cult-to-refuge-to-control reversal, includes one pre-copy anomaly, and ends in institutional reinterpretation rather than endpoint recovery or seven-Way classification. It does not reuse V5's four nearby fact pairs and matching clauses.
case_authoring_contract.cold_human_target_time_likely_theory_pat: Target 60-120 active minutes. Likely paths: ritual-origin, emergency-bunker-only, ordinary refuge, benevolent safety office, then safety/control reversal. Plausible wrong theories include clock failure, later forgery, a private cult school, evacuation-only use, and mkept fabricating the copies.

findings.question: What were the repeated Mouth marks before they were treated as rites?
findings.canonical_answer: THE MOUTH MARKS WERE SHIFT INSTRUCTIONS
accepted_normalized_answers: THE MOUTH MARKS WERE SHIFT INSTRUCTIONS
findings.required_inference: children copied the same sequence used by vent crews and bell wardens; it is an operational grammar, not an invocation

findings.question: Who was the Mouth and intake built to receive?
findings.canonical_answer: THE HOLD SHELTERED FAMILIES NOT INITIATES
accepted_normalized_answers: THE HOLD SHELTERED FAMILIES NOT INITIATES
THE HOLD WAS A LIVED IN REFUGE
findings.required_inference: school practice, pram and hinge repair, market debt, household berths, and public waiting space describe durable ordinary residence rather than selected ritual entrants

findings.question: What changed between the early smoke notice and the later office copy?
findings.canonical_answer: THE LATER COPY TURNED ADVICE INTO DUTY
accepted_normalized_answers: THE LATER COPY TURNED ADVICE INTO DUTY
THE WAYS TURNED SAFETY INTO OBEDIENCE
findings.required_inference: conditional mutual-aid wording becomes universal attendance, household entry, and penalty; provenance proves direction of change

findings.question: Why can the duplicated bell entry not be dismissed as an ordinary copy or bad clock?
findings.canonical_answer: THE REGISTER REPEATED BEFORE THE BELL
accepted_normalized_answers: THE REGISTER REPEATED BEFORE THE BELL
THE RECORD COPIED THE ENTRY BEFORE IT WAS WRITTEN
findings.required_inference: cartridge sequence, stable node clock, ink order, and identical correction establish a copy preserved before its stated source event; the cause remains unresolved

findings.question: What history do the four findings establish together?
findings.canonical_answer: REFUGE BEFORE RITE SAFETY BECAME OBEDIENCE
accepted_normalized_answers: REFUGE BEFORE RITE SAFETY BECAME OBEDIENCE
THE HOLD WAS A REFUGE BEFORE IT WAS A RITE SAFETY BECAME OBEDIENCE
THE HOLD WAS A RATIONAL REFUGE BEFORE RITUAL INSTITUTION
findings.required_inference: ordinary refuge and practical procedures predate ritual institution; the same need for legible safety enabled control while early anomalous preservation applied pressure
